description: This header file defines the LocalizationSettings class, which manages locale-specific formatting and localization details such as decimal separators, digit symbols, calendar identifiers, and first day of the week. It provides singleton access and methods for converting localized digits to English, removing group separators, and retrieving locale information.

classes.name: LocalizationSettings
classes.description: A singleton class that provides locale-aware formatting and localization information, including decimal separators, digit symbols, calendar identifiers, and first day of the week.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocalizationSettings.

methods.name: GetLocaleName
methods.description: Returns the resolved locale name.

methods.name: IsDigitEnUsSetting
methods.description: Checks if the current digit setting is US English (i.e., '0' maps to '0').

methods.name: GetEnglishValueFromLocalizedDigits
methods.description: Converts a localized string with digits to its English equivalent.

methods.name: RemoveGroupSeparators
methods.description: Removes group separators and spaces from a string.

methods.name: GetCalendarIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the calendar identifier based on locale.

methods.name: GetFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week according to locale.

methods.name: GetCurrencyTrailingDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of trailing digits for currency formatting.

methods.name: GetCurrencySymbolPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence of the currency symbol.

methods.name: GetDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character.

methods.name: GetDigitSymbolFromEnUsDigit
methods.description: Returns the localized digit symbol corresponding to an English digit.

methods.name: GetNumberGroupSeparator
methods.description: Returns the number group separator character.

methods.name: IsEnUsDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is an English digit (0-9).

methods.name: IsLocalizedDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a localized digit.

methods.name: IsLocalizedHexDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a localized hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: GetListSeparatorWinRT
methods.description: Returns the list separator as a WinRT string.

methods.name: GetDecimalSeparatorStrWinRT
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator as a WinRT string.

methods.name: LocalizeDisplayValue
methods.description: Localizes a string by replacing US digits with localized digits.

methods.name: GetDecimalSeparatorStr
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator as a string.

methods.name: GetNumberGroupingSeparatorStr
methods.description: Returns the number grouping separator as a string.

methods.name: GetNumberGroupingStr
methods.description: Returns the number grouping pattern.

methods.name: GetListSeparator
methods.description: Returns the list separator string.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes locale-specific formatting details using a DecimalFormatter.

methods.name: GetCalendarIdentifierFromCalid
methods.description: Maps a CALID to a calendar identifier string.
